correctness.rationale: Independent state variables are crucial: the images of the two subterms can be combined by the full Cartesian product, even when the two subterms have the same shape. Thus simultaneous subset closure describes exactly the images at height at most h. Before the first singleton, every nonstable round adds at least one of the eleven nonsingleton subsets, starting with Q already present. This gives at most eleven rounds to the first singleton; stabilization certifies infinity. A new batched frontier implementation exhausted all 4^10 tables for each of the five conjugacy representatives and matched all 60 entries, hence maxima 3, 7, 8, 10, 11. Weighting the rows by 1, 6, 3, 8, 6 gives 1,419,120 finite cases and 6*224=1,344 extremal pairs. I independently checked the code-739 table and masks 15,13,11,7,14,5,10,9,3,6,12,1; the stated recipes give those images with fresh leaves. A synchronizing pair with a four-cycle has trivial stabilizer: the centralizer of the unary cycle consists of its powers, and all nonidentity powers move the unique reset output. Directly partitioning the 224 extremal tables at the fixed four-cycle into four-element rotation orbits also gave 56 classes. These are four-state results for exactly the stated operations, with no constants or repeated leaf variables.
residual_risks: The enumeration is exhaustive in the stated finite universe only; it gives no higher-state or noncommutative classification. The supplied executables were not run; the new enumeration was run and compared with the record.

value.rationale: Commutativity and the conjugacy type of a unary permutation are intrinsic restrictions. The classification shows that the sharp reset height genuinely varies across these restrictions and that commutativity does not destroy sharpness at a four-cycle. The exact distributions and orbit count distinguish rare extremizers from a one-off witness and give an exact benchmark for full-context synchronization algorithms; they do not purport to establish any asymptotic law.
residual_risks: The scientific value is the complete natural finite classification, not a claim of improved universal bounds or broader algorithmic performance.
